messages:
Emma (PM): quick sync: AcmeCorp wants tenant-priority routing + rollback SLA. can we scope a pragmatic offering? :wave:
Raj (Eng Lead): options: soft priority (flagged routing preference) or reserved (paid dedicated pool). soft = cheaper but no SLO.
Sophie (C-Success): customer asks p95 <250ms and credits on breach. sales will push soft first.
Maria (SRE): soft cannot promise latency. reserved needs pinned capacity or quota and ops runbook. need eviction + spill metrics.
Raj (Eng Lead): rollout sketch: feature flag + phased rollout (1% internal -> 10% beta -> opt-in full). fallback = standard route, kill-switch ready.
Oliver (Prod Ops): gating: p95, error-rate, and "priority_spill_ratio" over 15m windows. automated failover if thresholds breach. include canary load test.
Contracts Bot: suggested credit examples: 10% credit for 1hr breach; 50% for full-day outage >50% affected.
Emma (PM): negotiation points: explicitly label SKUs (Priority-Soft vs Priority-Reserved), spell out measurement windows, and define credit formula.
Raj (Eng Lead): rough timeline: soft prototype 2 sprints; token-bucket + telemetry 3 sprints; reserved + billing/legal 6-8 sprints.
Maria (SRE): runbook tasks: implement spill_ratio metric, tracing markers, and eviction policy.
Oliver (Prod Ops): ops tasks: dashboard for tenant metrics, escalation playbook, and dry-run by 2026-04-15.
Sophie (C-Success): I'll draft customer FAQ and pricing delta for sales.
Emma (PM): decision: present two-tier offer and a rollout/playbook next Wed. I'll open GH issues and attach notes. :lock:
